data.name: Darshak
data.gender_notes: Darshak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Darshak means ‘observer’ or ‘seer’. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, as it is believed to be the name of the divine messenger or the one who reveals truth. The name Darshak carries the meaning “Observer, Seer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Darshak usually hope their child will grow to embody observer, seer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the power of vision and understanding, inspiring one to be a beacon of truth and wisdom.
data.etymology: Darshak belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Seer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darshak total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
